text:
Egor Chinakhov is still finding his feet in Pittsburgh. The former Blue Jacket has 7 points in 19 games as a Penguin, and only 3 in his last ten as his ice time slipped by more than a minute.

The goals are the part that should come. He has 3 on 4.7 expected, shooting 7.9% when his talent range sits around 13%. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking last season had him getting to the home-plate area in front of the net at an 83rd percentile rate and carrying the puck in on 54% of his entries. That's a scorer's profile, and his 21-goal season in Columbus last year says the same.

Pittsburgh is roughly even at 5-on-5 with him on the ice (50% of expected goals), slightly worse than without him. He isn't hurting the team, he just isn't tilting it yet. If the shooting comes back toward normal, our range has him finishing between 13 and 26 goals.
